description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget called Covid19Fragment that displays COVID-19 safety information and includes a button to open the CoWIN vaccination portal externally. It is a UI component for a mobile app.

classes.name: Covid19Fragment
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays COVID-19 safety tips and a button to open the vaccination portal.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the widget, including safety tips and a button to book vaccination.

methods.name: _buildSafetyTip
methods.description: Helper function to create a safety tip widget with an icon and text.

methods.name: _openCowin
methods.description: Opens the CoWIN portal URL in an external browser application.
